rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on every northstar_extension table, then drops theme_application, catalog_listing, extension_installation and the northstar_extension schema (CASCADE). extension_installation records which signed extensions a tenant activated and their granted trust tier, so on a shared environment export the schema first (uninstall policy export_then_delete) and restore from the pre-migration backup rather than dropping in place.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_extension schema with extension_installation, catalog_listing and theme_application tables exists
row-level security is enabled and forced on every northstar_extension table with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: Phase 5 extension module (signed install/upgrade, trust-tier gating, lifecycle stop, presentation-only themes, content-block schema validation, verified catalog) baseline
